intro.text: A woman from Sadeas's warcamp who followed her husband, Ned, to Urithiru.

items.text: Soon after they reached Urithiru, Rem tried to get a drunken Ned to leave All's Alley, and he strangled her, scraping her face with his ring. The next day a barmaid there was killed in exactly the same way, and the thugs guarding the bar, who knew the couple, killed Ned.
While investigating murders that might be tied to Sadeas's death, Shallan learned of Rem's death from Betha.
